annotations.title: Summarize what changed in a period

description: Summarize what changed in the served folder over a period: every document created, changed or removed, with the versions it started and ended on, and every embedded value that moved, before and after. Use it for what changed this week or since a date across the whole folder, read or not; for what changed of what the reader read use folio_changes, and for one document's versions folio_history. Answers {from, to, documents: [{path, status: created, changed or removed, from, to: version ids folio_history takes}], values: [{document, reference, before, after, at}]}, times ISO 8601. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

from.description: The period's start, an ISO 8601 date or time such as 2026-11-02 or 2026-11-02T09:00:00+01:00 - a date alone is midnight UTC, a time without an offset UTC; default a day before to

to.description: The period's end, an ISO 8601 date or time as from is; default now

name: folio_digest
title: Summarize what changed in a period
